keepouts.name: box-post-1
keepouts.why: Hammond 1590Q enclosure post (BOX1 pad, drill 4 mm): normal hole clearance, no part within 2.5 mm of the hole edge. Round 1 found check_assembly gates parts on these pads while place_simple did not avoid them.
